reply_text:
The workspace brain now has both a Gate 47 note and the old Dock 23 note for Marrow Agrisupply's new inbound lane. I couldn't remove the Dock 23 one.

- **Saved:** I added a new note that the site is Gate 47 and that it replaces Dock 23. It records that the correction came from Pree in #central-team.
- **Not removed:** When I tried to withdraw the Dock 23 note, the brain refused: this connection isn't allowed to remove that fact. The brain owner can remove it on the brain host with `gbrain forget 1`. Until then, a lookup will return both notes. The Gate 47 one says it supersedes the other, but the Dock 23 one isn't marked as out of date.

I replied in Pree's thread in #central-team to confirm the correction and explain that the old note is still there. I also told her I'd pass this on so it gets deleted, so please make sure the owner gets the command above.
